subject: geom_line with size depending on values of variable

messages.author: a424a73546ce9bc7
messages.subject: geom_line with size depending on values of variable
parts:
Hi
I am using geom_line to display the increase or decrease in traffic on a map (q is the map in the code below):

q + geom_line(data = changeflowAll[changeflow$Cuts>0,], aes(x = X1, y = X2, group = Id,size=Cuts),colour="blue")  + xlab("")+ylab("") + facet_grid(Mode+Direction~Scenario)

I have defined cuts that range from 0 to 1 in 0.1 steps. and the size of the line corresponds to the cuts. However, in the plot the biggest line is very, very thick (although the maximum value of cuts is 1).
Is there a way to reduce this size?

I have attaced one of the facets of the grid, where you easily can see what the problem is.

Thanks in advance for any suggestions.

Renger

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: geom_line with size depending on values of variable

Hi:

See the range = argument of scale_size:
http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/scale_size.html

Dennis
